newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0810 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Up 0.100 to 0.200 cent. Stronger cash markets but may be near top and rolling expected.
FEEDER CATTLE - Up 0.200 to 0.400 cent. Index up to new 26-month high and lower corn futures seen on active plantings.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to off 0.150 cent. Steady to lower live calls and cutout values continue to fall.
PORK BELLIES - Off 0.200 to 0.400 cent. Further losses in cash product but support may develop ahead of out-of-town.
